CustomField.description: Count of cases with Status value classified as Open. This field is for reporting only
CustomField.formula: IF(NOT( ISPICKVAL(Status,'Closed' ) || ISPICKVAL(Status,'Cancelled' ) || ISPICKVAL(Status,'Duplicate' ) || ISPICKVAL(Status,'Inactive' ) || ISPICKVAL(Status,'Complete' ) ), 1 , 0 )
CustomField.label: Count of Open Cases
